replacement.title: Use the space a forecheck leaves
replacement.objective: Recognize when a forechecker changes and choose a new regroup connection.
replacement.briefing: Navy attacks the Gold net. YOU carry from a wide neutral-zone lane; D2 is behind, F1 is ahead. Gold 1 continues pressuring YOU while Gold 2 changes its route toward D2. The open lane must be checked rather than assumed, not treated as guaranteed just because one forechecker moved. This is a selected-player teaching view; no movement is implied unless stated.
cues: Gold 2 changes its pressure route toward D2 while Gold 1 continues pressuring YOU.
D2 and F1 are visible connections.

replacement.title: Change the third player’s job twice
replacement.objective: Update a third-player support role after two possession changes.
replacement.briefing: Navy attacks Gold’s net. Gold 1 controls at this freeze. For the next branch, imagine F1 wins it and tries a pass to F2, then Gold 3 intercepts before F2 controls it. YOU must update the third-player job after each change. Those later events are stated possibilities, not a moving replay. This is a selected-player teaching view; no movement is implied unless stated.

YOU must distinguish present possession from the hypothetical later changes.
